note: no kernel profile (profile=none) on either side; every number below is same-model before/after on the same box in the same session

gap_to_llama_cpp.prefill: 19.0x slower at the best measured batched setting

tg_rungs.hawking_decode: 33.6 ms/token — fails TG20, deepest passed rung is TG40
tg_rungs.statement: TG is absolute latency for THIS model. Nothing here transfers to GLM.

batch_ceiling.measured: B=16 and B=32 are refused, not slow
batch_ceiling.already_widened: gemm_q4_k_m_batched_v3w_mma_n32 lifted the projection GEMM to 32 and is parity-tested, and the prefill path already calls it above B=8. The wall that remains is the fused FFN-down/SwiGLU/add/RMSNorm kernel plus three more 1..=8 guards in kernels/mod.rs.

fixed_cost_found_and_moved.symptom: with batched prefill on, decode reported 3.30 tok/s against 29.76 on the per-token path
fixed_cost_found_and_moved.measurement: decode_ms was 1212 at 4 tokens and 1747 at 20 tokens, so the marginal rate was 33.4 ms/token — identical to the per-token path's 33.6. The whole difference was a single fixed ~1076 ms charged to the first decode token.
fixed_cost_found_and_moved.why_not_the_kv_mirror: the cost was the same for a 43-token and a 422-token prompt. The KV mirror scales with prompt length (17 MB vs 166 MB); a fixed set of kernels does not.
fixed_cost_found_and_moved.cause: batched prefill and decode use disjoint kernel sets. forward_tokens_batch_tcb never touches the decode pipelines, so they were all created lazily at the first decode token. The per-token prefill path never had this because it IS forward_token_greedy_tcb.
fixed_cost_found_and_moved.fix: prefill now batches prompt_ids[..n-1] and runs the final token through forward_token_greedy_tcb. KV is unchanged: the token still lands once at pos n-1 and decode still re-feeds it at pos n.
fixed_cost_found_and_moved.honest_effect: this does NOT reduce total wall clock. It moves ~1076 ms out of decode and into prefill, and costs about 115 ms net at a 43-token prompt. What it buys is that dec_tps stops lying: 29.09 after the fix against a reported 3.30 before, for the same marginal rate.

crossover.reading: batched prefill's advantage shrinks with prompt length (1.54x at 43 tokens, 1.13x at 422) because attention grows quadratically while the weight-read amortization is constant. It is default-off and that remains the right default at short prompts.

parity: ' Paris. Paris is located in the northern part of France,' from both paths on the same prompt; 241 core tests pass
